net sales.heading: Equity net revenues up 41%:
net sales.text: • Equity net revenues increased on strong performance across businesses and regions driven by client engagement and strength in Asia.

Asset management.text: • Wealth Management delivered record net revenues of $9.1 billion on robust asset management fees and higher net interest income, generating a pre-tax margin of 30.4%. 14 The business attracted net new assets of $232 billion and fee-based flows of $80 billion for the quarter. 8,9

Investment banking.heading: Investment Banking net revenues up 2%:
Investment banking.text:
• Advisory revenues increased from a year ago on higher completed M&A activity in the Americas.

• Equity underwriting revenues decreased from a year ago on lower IPOs and blocks, partially offset by higher follow-on offerings.

• Fixed income underwriting revenues were modestly lower than the prior year period reflecting continued strength in investment grade and non-investment grade issuances.

Other.heading: Other:
Other.text: • Other net revenues decreased from a year ago primarily due to higher funding costs, partially offset by lower mark-to-market losses on corporate loans, inclusive of hedges.
